additional_info.subject: Handover notes
additional_info.body:
Customer (CPO) reported that if an endcustomer is charging cca.
between 110-150kW (charger is 160kW), then a paused & finished
status appears, and the session stops. Could you please check
based on the attached logs what is the reason for that? with lower
powers they do not experience this sudden session stop. Please
modify the file extension from .jpg to zip and check the ocpp logs
for the correct date & time info.

additional_info.subject: ID0445304-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP / S3 170003433]Voltage issue CRM:02698000441
additional_info.body:
Hi Norbert,
I checked the session from the time you provided to me and it seems like the EV is the one requesting the stop:
As you can see "source:"ev" means that our EcoG received a SessionStopRequest and is shutting down the session.
We recommend updating to v8.0.5 since we have updated the EcoG to have a extra set of V2G logs to help us prove that it's related to EV and not us.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
